podcast.title: Cover Repertoire
podcast.body: The Kansas City 5 covered songs by influential artists such as Ray Charles, Louis Jordan, and Big Joe Turner. "Those they've cited as ones they covered were Ray Charles, Louis Jordan, and Big Joe Turner."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Evolution from The Pagans
podcast.body: This group, an evolution from The Pagans, primarily performed jump blues, a genre where the musical tastes of Eric Burden and John Steele significantly overlapped. "as the pagans evolved into the Kansas City 5, or the Kansas City 7, depending on the occasional presence of two brass players."
